The '''Palace of Splendid Harmony''' was the governmental seat of [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]]. It was where The [[Ever Radiant Throne]] was overseen by the [[Rajah]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the palace was severely damaged however [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] managed to save it.<ref name="TCSE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
